  • Registrar's Office

  • Home
  • Registrar's Office

The Registrar’s Office maintains academic records for all Midway University students. The office provides oversight for the academic database, entering scheduled courses and assisting students with registration. Students may contact the registrar if they need transcripts, verification of enrollment or graduation, or if they need to initiate a request to waive or substitute a course for graduation. The registrar verifies eligibility for participation in intercollegiate athletics, determines transfer equivalencies from other institutions, and confers degrees for graduation.

Midway University Policy on Student Directory Information Requests
Midway University does not honor broad or blanket requests for student directory information from third parties, except as required under the provisions of the Solomon Amendment. The University remains firmly committed to safeguarding student privacy in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), the federal law that governs access to and the confidentiality of student education records.

Accordingly, requests for student data from entities not covered by the Solomon Amendment will not be fulfilled.
